citations.text: Barzilai, S., & Chinn, C. A. (2018). On the goals of epistemic education: Promoting apt epistemic performance. Journal of the Learning Sciences, 27(3), 353-389.
Barzilai, S., & Chinn, C. A. (2024). The AIR and Apt-AIR frameworks of epistemic performance and growth: Reflections on educational theory development. Educational Psychology Review, 36(3), 91.

en.general: Apt-AIR's fifth aspect: doing epistemic work with others, including jointly developing and applying epistemic norms and criteria, and attending to the fairness of who is heard. The 2018 article gives class-built criteria for judging models as an example.

examples: A class agrees criteria for judging a model and applies them.
A group weighs a quiet member's testimony fairly.
